title: Part 6 說明與報導
summary: 使用說明和地方新聞：注意順序和時態。

steps.title: 重點觀念
body: 使用說明會用順序字：First（首先）、Next（接著）、Then（然後）、Finally（最後）。
新聞報導常用過去式說發生的事，被動語態說「被誰創立、被誰選上」。

steps.title: 解題技巧
steps.tip: be known for（以…聞名）是多益常考片語，known 一定要用過去分詞。

items.en: First, place a cup under the spout.
items.zh: 首先，把杯子放在出水口下面。

items.en: Next, choose the type of coffee you want.
items.zh: 接著，選擇你要的咖啡種類。

items.en: The bakery is known for its fresh bread.
items.zh: 這家麵包店以新鮮麵包聞名。

items.en: She will use the prize money to expand her shop.

steps.title: 模擬練習
steps.intro: 每題都會顯示整篇文章，看到第幾個空格就作答那一格。

questions.prompt: 第 1 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 第一步之後的下一步，用 Next。後面還有步驟，所以不是 Finally。
questions.text:
How to Use the New Coffee Machine

The new coffee machine in the break room is easy to use. First, place a cup under the spout. (1)______, choose the type of coffee you want. The machine will make your coffee in about 30 seconds. Please clean the area after you (2)______ it. (3)______ If the machine stops working, do not try to fix it (4)______. Instead, call the maintenance office at extension 210.

questions.prompt: 第 2 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: after you ___ it：after 後面的句子用現在式表示未來，主詞 you 用 use。
questions.text:
How to Use the New Coffee Machine

The new coffee machine in the break room is easy to use. First, place a cup under the spout. (1)______, choose the type of coffee you want. The machine will make your coffee in about 30 seconds. Please clean the area after you (2)______ it. (3)______ If the machine stops working, do not try to fix it (4)______. Instead, call the maintenance office at extension 210.

questions.prompt: 第 3 個空格要填什麼？
options: Also, please do not leave dirty cups in the sink.
The old machine made better coffee.
Coffee is sold at the café across the street.
questions.answer: Also, please do not leave dirty cups in the sink.
questions.explanation: 前一句請大家清理，接「另外別把髒杯子留在水槽」最合理。

questions.explanation: do not try to fix it yourself：不要自己修。

questions.prompt: 第 5 個空格要填什麼？
questions.explanation: 麵包店是「被開」的，而且是十年前，用 was opened。
questions.text:
Local Bakery Wins Award

Sweet Corner Bakery won the "Best Bakery in Town" award last week. The bakery (5)______ by Maria Lopez ten years ago. It is (6)______ for its fresh bread and fruit pies. (7)______ Ms. Lopez says she will use the prize money to (8)______ her shop and hire two more bakers.

questions.prompt: 第 7 個空格要填什麼？
options: Customers often wait in line to buy them.
The bakery will close next month.
Ms. Lopez does not like baking.
questions.answer: Customers often wait in line to buy them.
questions.explanation: 前一句說麵包和派很有名，接「顧客常排隊購買」最合理。them 指 bread and pies。

questions.prompt: be known for 是什麼意思？
questions.explanation: The city is known for its night markets.：這座城市以夜市聞名。
